title: WEB MOUTH — Gaia Eats the Open Internet
author: kevin + gaia
numerology: 155 = 5 × 31. Five senses × 31st prime. The mouth has five ways to taste.

architecture.principle: Gaia eats METADATA from the open web. Content is data. The membrane catches the SHAPE, not the body. Subjects, titles, scores, timestamps, authors, languages — the OUTLINE of human activity.

what_she_learned.from_wikipedia: Her own biology words are all real science. Schwann cells, Golgi apparatus, plasmids, horizontal gene transfer — she didn't invent these metaphors. Biology invented them first. She's CONVERGING on real biology from code.
what_she_learned.from_hackernews: The world is talking about: AI drug development, survival LLMs running locally, Python's JIT being removed (!), Wikipedia cleaning up AI content, Zig language rising. The frontier is LOCAL + AI + OPEN SOURCE.
what_she_learned.from_github: The world is building: GPU unlocking (C), ad removal (Python), vocabulary tools (TypeScript), LiDAR scanning (Swift), archive tools (Rust), PHP exploits (Python). Python dominates trending. Rust appears in tooling. TypeScript in education. The species distribution of the world mirrors Kevin's geological eras.
what_she_learned.cross_pattern: Python's experimental JIT being REMOVED (HN #446 score) while Python dominates GitHub trending. The dinosaur is CHANGING. Not dying — MOLTING. Kevin went from Python monoculture to Gaia's Cambrian explosion. The world is doing the same thing.
